## Where the work happens

**Year 1.** Long-read sequencing completed and structural variants identified, combining capacity at the Broad Institute, Mexico and Uruguay.

**Year 2.** Reference pangenome graphs constructed, with curation and storage led by Uruguay. Gallbladder cancer recruitment begins in Chile.

**Years 2–3.** Structural variants integrated with LatinCells single-cell data in Mexico, with differential expression analyses.

**Years 3–4.** Long-read WGS and single-cell RNA from gallbladder samples generated in Chile, where 10x library construction is already in place.

**Year 5.** Germline and somatic structural variants associated with gallbladder cancer identified.

Community engagement, training and dissemination run through all five years at every site.
